title: National Defence Academy & Naval Academy (NDA & NA)
organization: Indian Armed Forces (Army, Navy, Air Force) via UPSC
qualification: 12th Class pass of 10+2 pattern (Army Wing); 12th with Physics & Mathematics (Air Force & Navy Wings). Appearing students eligible.
age_limit: 16.5 to 19.5 years at time of course commencement
physical_standards: Minimum Height: 157 cm (162.5 cm for Air Force Flying Branch; 152 cm for female candidates). Good physical endurance (run 2.4 km in 15 mins, push-ups, chin-ups).
medical_standards: Standard vision guidelines (6/6 or correctable as per service rules). No skeletal deformity or colour blindness for Air Force.
selection_stages: Stage 1: UPSC Written Examination (Paper 1: Mathematics - 300 marks; Paper 2: General Ability Test - 600 marks)
Stage 2: 5-Day Services Selection Board (SSB) Interview (Officer Intelligence Rating, PPDT, Psychological Tests, Group Testing Officer Tasks, Personal Interview, Board Conference)
Stage 3: Medical Examination at Military Hospital
Stage 4: Final All India Merit List based on Written (900) + SSB (900) = 1800 marks
training_academy: National Defence Academy (Khadakwasla, Pune) for 3 years (grants JNU B.Sc/BA/B.Tech degree) + 1 year at IMA/INA/AFA
rank_on_commission: Lieutenant (Army) / Sub Lieutenant (Navy) / Flying Officer (Air Force)
pay_scale: 7th CPC Level 10 (Rs 56,100 - 1,77,500) + Military Service Pay (MSP Rs 15,500/month) + DA + allowances
application_cycle: Conducted twice a year (NDA I notification in December, exam in April; NDA II notification in May, exam in September)

title: 10+2 Technical Entry Scheme (TES) - Indian Army
entry_type: After 12th Class (Technical Officer Entry - Direct SSB)
qualification: 10+2 pass with minimum 60% aggregate in Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics (PCM) + Mandatory appearance in JEE (Main).
physical_standards: Min height 157 cm, healthy physique, standard eyesight (myopia not exceeding -3.50D).
selection_stages: Shortlisting based on JEE (Main) Common Rank List (CRL) cutoff
Direct 5-Day SSB Interview call at Selection Centres (Allahabad, Bhopal, Bengaluru, Jalandhar)
Special Medical Board (SMB)
All India Merit List
training_academy: 4 Years total: 1 Year Basic Military Training at Cadets Training Wing (CME Pune / MCTE Mhow / MCEME Secunderabad) + 3 Years Technical degree course (Grants B.Tech in Engineering).
rank_on_commission: Lieutenant (Permanent Commission in Corps of Engineers, Signals, or EME)

title: 10+2 (B.Tech) Cadet Entry Scheme - Indian Navy
entry_type: After 12th Class (Naval Officer Entry - Direct SSB)
qualification: 10+2 with minimum 70% aggregate in PCM and minimum 50% marks in English (10th or 12th) + Mandatory valid JEE (Main) B.E./B.Tech rank.
physical_standards: Min height: 157 cm (Male), 152 cm (Female). Standard naval eyesight and colour perception standards.
selection_stages: Shortlisting based on JEE Main All India Rank
Services Selection Board (SSB) 5-Day Interview at Bhopal, Bangalore, Visakhapatnam, or Kolkata
Naval Medical Examination at designated Naval Hospital
All India Merit List
training_academy: 4-Year B.Tech course at Indian Naval Academy (INA Ezhimala, Kerala) in Applied Electronics & Communication, Mechanical, or Electronics (degree awarded by JNU). All training expenses borne by Indian Navy.
rank_on_commission: Sub Lieutenant (Executive, Engineering, or Electrical Branch)
pay_scale: 7th CPC Level 10 (Rs 56,100) + MSP Rs 15,500 + Sea Duty Allowances

title: Agnipath Scheme (Army, Navy & Air Force)
qualification: Army General Duty / Navy MR: 10th pass with 45% aggregate; Army Technical / Navy SSR / Air Force Vayu Science: 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry/Maths with 50% aggregate.
selection_stages: Stage 1: Online Common Entrance Examination (CEE / STAR / INET)
Stage 2: Physical Fitness Test (PFT: 1.6 km run in 5.5 - 6 mins, beam pull-ups, 9ft ditch, zig-zag balance)
Stage 3: Physical Measurement Test (PMT) & Adaptability Test
Stage 4: Medical Examination
tenure_benefits: 4 Years tenure with 25% selected into permanent regular cadre. Monthly package: 1st Year Rs 30,000 to 4th Year Rs 40,000. Upon exit: Seva Nidhi corpus (~Rs 11.71 Lakhs tax-free) + Skill Certificate + reservation in CAPFs & State Police.

title: Combined Defence Services (CDS Examination)
entry_type: Graduate Officer Entry (After Any Degree / B.Tech)
qualification: Degree of a recognized University for IMA & OTA; Degree in Engineering for INA; Degree with Physics & Maths at 10+2 or Bachelor of Engineering for Air Force Academy.
age_limit: IMA: 19-24 years; INA: 19-24 years; AFA: 20-24 years; OTA (Men & Women): 19-25 years
gender_marital: IMA, INA, AFA: Unmarried Males; OTA: Unmarried Males, Unmarried Females, and Issueless Widows
selection_stages: Written Examination by UPSC (IMA/INA/AFA: English, GK, Elementary Maths - 300 marks; OTA: English & GK - 200 marks)
5-Day Services Selection Board (SSB) Interview (Stage I: OIR & PPDT screening; Stage II: Psychology, GTO indoor/outdoor ground tasks, Personal Interview, Final Conference)
Comprehensive Medical Examination at Special Medical Board (SMB)
Final Merit List based on aggregate Written + SSB scores
academies: Indian Military Academy (Dehradun), Indian Naval Academy (Ezhimala), Air Force Academy (Dundigal Hyderabad), Officers Training Academy (Chennai)

title: Air Force Common Admission Test (AFCAT)
entry_type: Graduate Officer Entry (Flying, Technical, Ground Duty)
qualification: Flying Branch: Min 50% in Maths & Physics at 10+2 + Graduation (min 60%) or B.Tech (min 60%); Technical Branch: B.E./B.Tech (min 60%) in Electronics / Mechanical / Allied; Ground Duty Non-Tech: Graduate degree (min 60%) in any stream.
age_limit: Flying Branch: 20 to 24 years; Ground Duty (Tech / Non-Tech): 20 to 26 years
gender_marital: Men and Women candidates (Permanent Commission for Men; Short Service Commission for Men & Women)
selection_stages: Computer Based Test (AFCAT online test: Verbal Ability, Numerical Ability, Reasoning & Military Aptitude, General Awareness - 300 marks)
Air Force Selection Board (AFSB) 5-Day Testing at Dehradun, Mysuru, Gandhinagar, or Varanasi
Computerised Pilot Selection System (CPSS) for Flying Branch candidates (once in a lifetime test)
Medical Examination at Air Force Central Medical Establishment (AFCME)
training_academy: Air Force Academy (Dundigal, Hyderabad) - 74 weeks for Flying & Tech; 52 weeks for Non-Tech
pay_scale: 7th CPC Level 10 (Rs 56,100) + MSP Rs 15,500 + Flying Allowance (Rs 25,000/mo for pilots)

title: Technical Graduate Course (TGC) - Indian Army
qualification: B.E. / B.Tech in relevant engineering streams (Civil, Mechanical, Electrical, ECE, CSE, IT, Metallurgy, Chemical, Architecture) with required cutoff percentage. Final year students eligible.
selection_stages: Shortlisting based on engineering cumulative percentage / CGPA cutoff
Direct 5-Day SSB Interview (No written exam needed)
Medical Examination by Military Medical Board
All India Merit List
training_academy: Indian Military Academy (IMA Dehradun) for 49 weeks
pay_scale: 7th CPC Level 10 (Rs 56,100) + MSP Rs 15,500 + High Altitude / Field Allowances

title: Short Service Commission (Tech) Men & Women - Indian Army
qualification: B.E. / B.Tech in specified engineering disciplines with cut-off marks. Final year students eligible.
gender_marital: Unmarried Male and Unmarried Female candidates
selection_stages: Shortlisting based on B.Tech percentage cutoff
Direct 5-Day SSB Interview at Selection Centres
Medical Board Examination
Merit List
training_academy: Officers Training Academy (OTA Chennai) for 49 weeks
commission_type: Short Service Commission (10 years initial, extendable up to 14 years or eligible for Permanent Commission option)

title: Indian Navy SSC Officer (Executive & Technical Branches)
qualification: B.E. / B.Tech with minimum 60% aggregate in Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, Computer Science, IT, Naval Architecture, Civil, Marine Engineering.
selection_stages: Shortlisting based on normalised B.Tech marks
Direct 5-Day SSB Interview at Bhopal, Bangalore, Visakhapatnam, Coimbatore
Naval Medical Examination
Merit List
training_academy: Indian Naval Academy (INA Ezhimala, Kerala) for 22 weeks basic naval orientation
branches: Executive (General Service, Hydro, IT, Pilot, Observer, Air Traffic Controller), Technical (Engineering Branch, Electrical Branch, Naval Architect)
pay_scale: 7th CPC Level 10 (Rs 56,100) + MSP Rs 15,500 + Submarine/Flight/Sea allowances
